svg.title: effortless, recorded in a running Claude Code session
svg.desc: A prompt is being typed: rename getUser to fetchUser. Above it, two words read opus high. Control plus five stretches them into a bar at max, which fills the line with a rainbow. Shift plus left four times walks the dot through xhigh, high and medium to low, changing color at each step. Shift plus down twice unfolds the grid and moves to haiku. It folds back to the words haiku low, and the draft never moves.
